representation.name: Inspect match genotype archive q1
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
mkdir work
cd work
tar -xzf "$(inputs.archive.path)"
{
  printf 'FILES\n'
  find . -maxdepth 1 -type f | sort
  for f in ./*.psam ./*.pvar ./*.csv; do
    printf '\n== %s ==\n' "$f"
    wc -l "$f"
    head -n 8 "$f"
  done
} > ../inspection.txt
